name: Regularidad de Autocorrelación
description: Detecta periodic autocorrelación peaks that suggest resampling or AI upsampling artefactos in the image structure.
mechanism: Computes the normalized autocorrelación function over grayscale pixel rows and columns at multiple lags. Periodic peaks in the autocorrelación indicate resampling artefactos from interpolation or AI upsampling, que produce predictable periodicity absent in natural images captured directly by camera sensors.
parameters: Max lag: 32 pixels, Tamaño de bloque: 128x128. Sampling: row+column pairs, Normalization: zero-lag division
accuracy: Moderate — 65-78%, best combined with análisis espectral
source: Popescu & Farid (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP
useCase: Detecting resampling and upsampling artefactos characteristic of AI image generation pipelines

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.
Kirchner, M. (2008). Fast and Reliable Resampling Detection by Spectral Analysis of Fixed Linear Predictor Residue. ACM MM&Sec.

strengths:
• Detecta resampling artefactos invisible to human eye
• Fast computation on local pixel blocks
• Mathematical foundation in signal processing
• Complementary to spectral Nyquist análisis
limitations:
• Sensitivity drops with heavy compresión JPEG
• Natural textures with periodic patrones cause falsos positivos
• Small images may not have enough data
• Some AI models avoid resampling entirely
